name: Number of graphs with n vertices that have no induced regular subgraph of order 6.
comment: The sequence eventually becomes 0. It is known that a(27) >= 16, but it is not known whether a(28) > 0.
link: Paul W. Dyson and Brendan D. McKay, Ramsey numbers for regular induced subgraphs, arXiv:2604.08215 [math.CO] (2026).
Paul Dyson and Brendan McKay, Ramsey Graphs (section Regular induced subgraphs)
S. Fajtlowicz, T. McColgan, T. Reid, and W. Staton, Ramsey numbers for induced regular subgraphs, Ars Combinatoria, 39 (1995) 149-154.
example: An example with 25 vertices is the lexicographic product of the pentagon with itself.
xref: Cf. A394573 (subgraphs of order 4), A394539 (order 5), A394930 (order 7), A392636 (order 6 or greater).
author: _Brendan McKay_, Mar 21 2026
